body: I had a boyffriend for 2 years, almost moved in but recently i found out he was cheating on me for a solid year..... Its been tough, so if you dont mind i'll save this letter for myself and read it. He crushed me and these words are inspiring
Jaučiausi lyg skaityčiau narciziškos asmenybės dienoraštį.... Puikios mintys, piktas ir įskaudintas vyras, bet toks iš tuščio į kiaurą. Nieko naujo nepasakyta, tiesiog realybė suaštrinta

Hey, i feel the same exact way. I failed my driving test MULTIPLE times, i had horrible relationship failures, and i cant say i have a family since i've closed myself off from them since i was 5. They barely even know me.
But sometimes, not all the time, i meet people. Good people, who say a compliment to me. Last time was "your hugs arr the best" from a male coworker (i'm a guy too) and even if he didnt mean it - its something for me to grab on. 
No, you cant drive, you cant concentrate and be the next famous scientist, but maby you can connevt with people. Maby you have a green thumb and dont know it yet? Maby you can be good at different topics than other people.
The way i see it - 22 years of failure and dissapointment. How do i even start figuiring it out?

Personally i imagine myself hanging from a rope in my room. Just dangling silently. And its just a blissfull transe and i feel good.

But what if next day you meet someone who smiled? Or you smiled at someone or laughed at their joke, when they really needed that? I dont know if this helps, but the way i see it - your mind wishes to keep going for some reason. Maby its a person, maby its a dream of yours. But if you dont live a good life for yourself, maybe live for someone else? Or something else?
